summary: Report live Core ISO URL download bytes and show progress in Storage and Tasks

guide.reason: Operators can now read live URL download bytes and a percentage when the public server provides a total.

api.reason: Core reports ManagedState.iso_downloads after a v2 iso_download_progress acknowledgement; Controller mirrors validated samples in GET /api/v1/hosts inventory. ISO submission, command, outcome and retry contracts stay the same.

roadmap.reason: This corrects progress reporting for an existing ISO import capability and changes no milestone status.

state.reason: The active transfer and byte samples belong to Nex Core. Controller only mirrors the latest observation.
state.record: The host managed journal records the ISO import and bounded byte samples. A fresh Controller adopts the completed ISO with its identity, name, size and hash through Core managed inventory; it ignores progress for an operation it never submitted.

verification.method: Run focused Core and Controller progress/recovery regressions, the UI test and typecheck/build, API contract and documentation gates, and a simulated Chromium walkthrough of Storage and Tasks; inspect its capture.
